iPayX MCP Server — Documentation

Connect your AI agent to real-time FX audit verdicts.

1. Endpoints

* Production MCP: hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-server
* Documentation: hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-server/docs

2. Available Tools

audit_fx_transaction

Free tier
Score any FX transaction 1-10 with a qualitative verdict. Spread % and mid-market rate are never returned in the public response.
Input
{
  "amount": 10000,
  "currency_from": "USD",
  "currency_to": "EUR",
  "bank_rate": 0.9123,
  "date": "2026-05-13"
}
Output (opaque public response)
{
  "score": 7,
  "color": "yellow",
  "verdict": "Fair FX pricing",
  "currency_pair": "USD/EUR",
  "amount": 10000,
  "date": "2026-05-13",
  "encouragement": null
}
Rate limit: 10 audits / day per API key (free).

full_forensic_fx_report

Paid tier ($199)
Full forensic audit including spread breakdown, projected loss, and partner routing intelligence. Requires a paid Bearer token.
Input
{
  "audit_id": "uuid",
  "include_routing": true
}
Output (opaque public response)
{
  "audit_id": "uuid",
  "score": 4,
  "color": "orange",
  "verdict": "FX pricing above market expectations",
  "spread_pct": 2.21,
  "mid_market_rate": 0.9241,
  "projected_annual_loss_usd": 184500,
  "recommended_partner": "ebury"
}
Rate limit: Unlimited on paid tier; priority routing.

check_fx_mid_market_rate

Free tier
Fetch the live mid-market reference rate for a currency pair. Returns both directions to help detect inverted quotes.
Input
{
  "base": "USD",
  "quote": "EUR"
}
Output (opaque public response)
{
  "pair": "USD/EUR",
  "mid_market_rate": 0.9241,
  "inverted_pair": "EUR/USD",
  "inverted_mid_rate": 1.0821,
  "as_of": "2026-05-13T12:00:00Z"
}
Rate limit: 60 calls / minute per API key.

3. Authentication

* Method: HTTP Bearer token in Authorization header.
* Format: ipx_live_xxxxx (production) or ipx_test_xxxxx (sandbox).
* How to get a key: Open your iPayX dashboard → API keys.
Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json, text/event-stream

4. Compatible MCP Clients

* Claude Desktop / Claude.ai
* ChatGPT (via OpenAI Apps SDK)
* Microsoft Azure Foundry Agents — setup guide
* Cursor / Continue / Cline
* Lovable Agent

iPayX FX Proof API

Audit FX transactions against the mid-market rate. Returns the hidden spread, true cost, and an FX score (1–10).
Base URL
api.ipayx.ai/v1
Authentication
Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_…

Submit up to 50 FX transactions per request. The API fetches the mid-market rate at the time of each transaction, computes the spread and implicit cost, and returns an FX execution score for the batch.

@ipayx/mcp-fx-audit

MCP server for iPayX Protocol — audit FX fees, compare currency conversion margins and score cross-border payment invoices, directly inside Claude, Cursor, Cline, ChatGPT or any MCP-compatible AI client.
npm License: MIT

Exposes 4 tools to your AI assistant:
* Tool | Description
* audit_fx_fee | Compute the hidden FX fee on a conversion vs the real mid-market rate
* compare_providers | Compare live FX quotes across Wise, OFX, Airwallex, banks, etc.
* score_invoice | Grade an invoice 0–100 on FX fairness with explanation

npx -y @smithery/cli install @ipayx/mcp-fx-audit --client claude

Parameters:
* from_currency (string) - Source currency code

Auth: None | Cost: Free

sources.title: iPayX Protocol — FINTRAC-registered FX forensic audit layer
sources.trimmed:
# iPayX Protocol — Neutral FX Verification Layer

iPayX Protocol is the neutral FX verification layer for fintech sales teams and FX brokers. We audit foreign-exchange transactions, compare the rate a bank or card network applied against the real-time mid-market rate, reveal invisible spreads, quantify FX costs, and project annual savings.

## How It Works

* Enter your transaction – Amount, currencies (e.g. CAD → USD), and the rate your bank applied.
* We capture the mid-market rate – From regulated interbank data sources at the exact transaction time.
* Instant audit report – Spread %, FX cost in your base currency, execution grade (A/B/C), and annual savings projection.

## Trust & Compliance

MSB FINTRAC C10001283 | 0-custody | AES-256 | Built in Canada 🇨🇦

## Links

Contact: info@ipayx.ai

FX Audit API

The forensic FX audit engine that powers iPayX. Detect hidden bank spreads vs mid-market benchmark on any currency transaction. Bearer auth, OpenAPI 3.1, signed webhooks.
Get an API key  OpenAPI Spec
3 endpoints
audit · rates · audit/document
Signed webhooks
HMAC-SHA256 · audit.completed
Marketplace ready
Zapier · n8n · MCP

Authentication

Every request requires a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Keys start with ipx_live_.
HTTP
Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx

Base URL

URL
hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/fx-public-api-v1
POST

/audit

Run a forensic audit on a single transaction. Returns a 0–10 score, hidden spread vs mid-market, and estimated loss.
cURLJavaScriptPython
bash
curl -X POST hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/fx-public-api-v1/audit \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "amount": 50000,
    "currency_from": "USD",
    "currency_to": "EUR",
    "bank_rate": 0.91
  }'

Response

json
{
  "score_1_to_10": 4,
  "score_rating": "poor",
  "hidden_spread_pct": 1.85,

  "api_version": "v1"
}
GET
